_why: The two files under `frontend/headless_app/` and `common/` named below are
VERBATIM copies of CodeTracer's `src/frontend/headless_app/layout_model.nim`
and the `src/common/contributed_pane_id.nim` it imports. Together they are
the session/layout model: a description of what a replay session shows,
carrying no renderer, no measurement and no engine. BlockTracer composes its
OWN arrangement from these primitives in `../session_layout.nim`; it does not
call `defaultReplayLayout()`.
WHY A COPY AND NOT AN IMPORT. The reason is the one `flow_layout.vendor.json`
beside this file gives, and it is a property that was MEASURED rather than
assumed: `client/src` compiles with NO CodeTracer source on the Nim path at
all. On 2026-09-17, with `CODETRACER_SRC` unset and no codetracer path in
`client/nim.cfg`, `cd client && just export` rendered all 348 pages and both
`nim js` bundles. That is what makes `client/hydrate/build.sh` exit 3 a VALID
outcome — no Embed SDK, no bundle, no `<script>`, and the site still builds
and serves exactly the page this route has always served (AGENTS.md §1b,
Page-Descriptions §7.0). An import here would convert an optional dependency
into a mandatory one for the whole static site, because `components/
debugger.nim` is on the export's import closure.
AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS NOTE GAVE STALE EVIDENCE, and it is corrected
here rather than repeated. It said `flake.nix` "pins isonim, nim-everywhere
and the design system and nothing else, so `nix build .#default` has no
CodeTracer checkout on the Nim path at all". The first half is no longer
true: `flake.nix` has carried a `codetracer` input since hydration landed,
pinned to `ci/embed-sdk-pin.env`'s `CODETRACER_REF`, and `packages.default`
sets `CODETRACER_SRC` from it. The TREE is available. What is not available
is a Nim path from `client/src` to it, and that — not the absence of a
checkout — is the property above. Availability was never the constraint, so
a sibling checkout does not change this answer either.
The module itself also asks to be vendored rather than reached into. Its
header says the model lives on the CONSUMER side of the SDK boundary because
'arranging panes is the embedder's job' — it is deliberately NOT exported
through `codetracer_embed.nim`, and `src/frontend/headless_app/` carries its
own `.sdk-consumer` marker over there. There is no facade route to it, so
reaching into `headless_app/` from here would be exactly the internal-module
import that M8a's `test_thin_slice_uses_only_the_sdk_facade` forbids.
WHY THE DIRECTORY LOOKS LIKE CODETRACER'S. `layout_model.nim` imports
`../../common/contributed_pane_id`. Mirroring the directory levels that
import crosses is what lets BOTH files stay byte-identical to upstream — the
alternative is a one-line edit to the import path, and a vendored copy with
one edit in it is a copy whose hash can no longer be compared to anything.
This is the same mirror `flow_layout.vendor.json` describes and the same
`vendor/` root, so there is one vendor tree shaped like CodeTracer's `src/`
rather than two conventions for one idea.
WHAT KEEPS THE COPY HONEST is `ci/test/layout-model-vendor.sh`:
A. the bytes here still hash to the sha256s below (no local edits), and
the commit below EQUALS `ci/embed-sdk-pin.env`'s `CODETRACER_REF`, and
B. against a real CodeTracer checkout, a probe imports BOTH copies and
compares what a consumer observes — `defaultReplayLayout()`, `allPanes`,
`visiblePanes`, the enum spellings, `LayoutSchemaVersion` and
`validate` — so a structural change upstream fails here rather than
leaving BlockTracer arranging panes to a shape nobody else has.
NOTE ON THE COMMIT, AND WHY IT IS NOW THE SDK PIN. Until 2026-09-17 this
manifest named the MODULE's own mainline (`eb1776ea`) while part B compared
the copy against `$CODETRACER_SRC`, i.e. the EMBED SDK pin — two different
commits by design. A gate that pins to one commit and compares against
another asks a question with no passable answer: every SDK bump reddened it
whether or not this module had changed, and the `viewmodels` job was red by
construction. `flow_layout.vendor.json` never had that defect because its
commit IS the pin. This one now is too, checked by part A rather than
described here, so the two vendor gates are one shape and a red gate means a
real upstream change with a diff to read.
